# botyard_bot_soul (Resource)

Manages the complete soul (instructions) of a hosted native bot (`hosting_type = "hosted"`, `harness = "botyard_native"`) through the platform's bot-files API, not `native_config`. Use at most one `botyard_bot_soul` per bot. Creating this resource adopts and, if different, replaces the existing soul. Edits made outside Terraform are detected on refresh and overwritten on the next apply. Pack soul changes are also outside edits: this resource owns the **whole** soul, including any pack text.

**Removal is non-destructive:** destroying this resource or changing `bot_slug` leaves the previous bot's soul and revision history intact. Native souls must contain non-whitespace text; empty content is not supported. Writes create a revision only when content differs and take effect for subsequent native turns. This is a separate resource applied after bot creation; the bot initially has its platform/pack soul.

Requires API key permissions `bot:file.read`, `bot:file.update`, and permission to read the bot. Content is stored in Terraform state and may appear in plans; do not put secrets in it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "botyard_bot" "assistant" {
  name         = "Native Assistant"
  hosting_type = "hosted"
  harness      = "botyard_native"
}

# Manage the full soul, not native_config. External edits (including pack
# changes) are detected on refresh and overwritten on the next apply.
resource "botyard_bot_soul" "assistant" {
  bot_slug = botyard_bot.assistant.slug
  content  = file("${path.module}/SOUL.md")
}

# Removing this resource leaves the live soul and its history intact.
# Native soul content must contain non-whitespace text; it cannot be cleared.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bot_slug` (String) Slug of the hosted native bot. Changing it forces replacement; the old soul is preserved.
- `content` (String) Complete soul markdown, for example `file("${path.module}/SOUL.md")`. Maximum 102400 characters. Must contain non-whitespace text; empty or whitespace-only content is rejected at plan time. Never include secrets.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The bot slug.
- `version` (Number) Current platform soul revision number.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the current soul using the hosted native bot's slug.
terraform import botyard_bot_soul.assistant native-assistant
```
